parsed_payload.reasoning: We have d_n = gcd(100+n^2,2n+1). Since 2n+1 divides (2n+1)(2n-1)=4n^2-1, we get 4(100+n^2)=400+4n^2 ≡ 401 mod (2n+1). Because 2n+1 is odd, gcd(100+n^2,2n+1)=gcd(2n+1,401). Since 401 is prime, the maximum possible gcd is 401, achieved when 2n+1=401, i.e. n=200. Thus the maximum value of d_n is 401.
